messages.subject: Error while running Wallace: in ENMeval::ENMevaluate: unused argument (parallelType = "doSNOW")
messages.subject_clean: Error while running Wallace: in ENMeval::ENMevaluate: unused argument (parallelType = "doSNOW")
messages.body_plain:
Good afternoon,

I'm trying to run a simple model (it is for teaching purposes), everything seems to work until I run the model, then Wallace freezes and I get the following message in the R console:
Warning: Error in ENMeval::ENMevaluate: unused argument (parallelType = "doSNOW")  83: model_maxent 82: observe [C:\Users\m\AppData\Local\R\win-library\4.4\wallace\shiny\modules\model_maxent.R#148] 81: <observer:observeEvent(input$goMaxent)> 2: shiny::runApp 1: run_wallace

It happens even when I specify parallel =FALSE, and every package is updated.

How can I solve it?

Thank you very much for your time and sorry for any inconvenience.

Best wishes,

Marta

messages.subject: Addressing "ENMeval::ENMevaluate: unused argument (parallelType = "doSNOW")" Error
messages.body_plain:
Dear Wallace Community,

We are aware that the current CRAN version of Wallace (2.1.3) is experiencing errors due to the recent update of the ENMeval package (2.0.5). We are actively working on a new version to address these issues, which we plan to release very soon.

In the meantime, if you need to perform analyses using Wallace, you can use the development version available on GitHub. This can be installed using the devtools package with the following command:

devtools::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace", ref = "dev")

Please note: this development version is a work in progress, and while the core functionalities are operational, it may still contain some bugs.

We will provide an update as soon as the new version is available on CRAN.

Daniel Lopez
The Wallace Team
